questions.question: Which type of sensor is used for burglar alarms? a). Ultrasonic sensor b). Gas sensor c). PIR sensor d). Voltage sensor
questions.solution_html:
• c) PIR sensor
  • Noise Reduction
  • Filters remove unwanted electrical noise and interference from sensor signals
  • improving measurement accuracy.
  • Hydraulic and Pneumatic Systems – To monitor and control fluid or air pressure
  • for safe and efficient operation.
  • Range and Sensitivity: The transducer should accurately measure within the
  • required range and be sensitive enough to detect small changes.
  • No external power supply needed
  • Active transducers generate their own electrical signal from the input energy
  • (like heat, pressure, or motion), making them self -sufficient and easy to use
  • in remote areas.
  • Low output signal level
  • The electrical signal generated is often weak and needs amplification before
  • further processing.
  • Precise Movement and Positioning
  • Linear actuators enable accurate control of movement in filling, cutting, or sorting
  • machines, ensuring consistent product quality and portion sizes.
  • Current and Voltage Isolation:.
  • Reduces Human Exposure to Dangerous Tasks
  • Automated machines handle hazardous operations such as handling chemicals
  • high temperatures, heavy loads, or toxic gases, keeping workers away from
  • direct danger.
  • Process Monitoring and Control
  • • Sensors continuously measure physical parameters like temperature
  • pressure, level, flow, and humidity.
  • • Transducers convert these physical quantities into electrical signals for
  • processing.
  • • Example: In a chemical plant, a temperature sensor with a thermocouple
  • transducer monitors reactor temperature to maintain safe and optimal
  • reactions.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025
questions.final_answer: reactions.

questions.question: Which application requires accurate current sensing? a). Lighting a bulb b). Smart energy meters c). Measuring sound d). Recording video
questions.solution_html:
• b) Smart energy meters
  • Improved Signal Quality
  • Filtering ensures that only the useful frequency components of a signal are retained
  • providing a cleaner and more reliable signal.
  • Process Industries (Oil, Gas, Chemical) – To measure and regulate pressure in
  • pipelines, reactors, and storage tanks.
  • Accuracy and Linearity: It must provide precise and linear output over its
  • operating range to ensure reliable measurements.
  • Simple design and lower power consumption
  • Since they don’t require external excitation circuits, the overall system
  • design is simpler and consumes less power.
  • Limited to dynamic measurements
  • Active transducers generally cannot measure static or steady-state quantities
  • effectively (e.g., constant pressure or displacement).
  • Automation of Repetitive Tasks
  • They automate manual processes such as pushing, lifting, and adjusting
  • components—improving efficiency, speed, and productivity.
  • Ability to Switch High-Power Loads
  • Minimizes Accidents Due to Human Error
  • Automation ensures consistent, precise, and controlled operations , reducing
  • mistakes that can lead to injuries, equipment damage, or hazardous spills.
  • Automation and Efficiency
  • • Sensors provide real-time data that allow machines to operate automatically
  • without human intervention, reducing errors and increasing productivity.
  • • Example: In a bottling plant, level sensors detect liquid in bottles and
  • trigger filling machines automatically.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025
questions.final_answer: trigger filling machines automatically.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a type of potentiometer? a). Rotary b). Capacitive c). Digital d). Linear
questions.solution_html:
• b) Capacitive
  • Prevention of Aliasing:.
  • Before analog -to-digital conversion, filters (especially low -pass filters) prevent
  • high-frequency components from causing aliasing errors.
  • Automotive Industry – Used in tire pressure monitoring systems (TPMS), fuel
  • systems, and engine oil pressure monitoring.
  • Response Time: The transducer should have a fast enough response to capture
  • changes in the measured quantity.
  • High reliability and portability
  • Fewer components and no dependency on an external power source make
  • these transducers more reliable and suitable for portable or field applications.
  • Disadvantages
  • Environmental sensitivity
  • Their performance can be affected by temperature changes, vibrations, or
  • other environmental factors, reducing accuracy in harsh conditions.
  • Improved Hygiene and Safety
  • Electric an d pneumatic linear actuators can be designed with stainless steel and
  • sealed housings, suitable for washdown environments, ensuring compliance with
  • food safety standards.
  • Safety and Protection
  • Remote Monitoring and Control
  • Sensors and control systems allow operators to monitor and control machinery
  • remotely, reducing the need for physical presence in risky areas.
  • Safety and Hazard Prevention
  • • Sensors detect unsafe conditions and trigger alarms or shutdowns to prevent
  • accidents.
  • • Example: Gas sensors in an oil refinery detect leaks and automatically
  • activate ventilation or emergency systems.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025
questions.final_answer: activate ventilation or emergency systems.

  • shutdown mechanisms to quickly stop machines in case of faults or unsafe
  • conditions.
  • Quality Control
  • • Sensors ensure products meet required specifications, maintaining consistent
  • quality.
  • • Example: Optical sensors in food processing detec t defective items on a
  • conveyor belt and remove them.
